Name: Liang Wei

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Research Intern, Institute of High Energy Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences. Assisted in the calibration of particle detectors for a large-scale neutrino experiment. Developed Python scripts to automate data preprocessing and analysis workflows. Collaborated with senior researchers to optimize algorithms for event selection and background reduction. Presented interim findings at weekly group meetings and contributed to technical documentation. Conducted literature reviews on advanced detector technologies and summarized key insights for the team.
- 2022--2022: Summer Intern, Shanghai Synchrotron Radiation Facility. Supported beamline scientists in conducting experiments on condensed matter physics using synchrotron radiation. Analyzed experimental data with MATLAB and produced visualizations for research reports. Participated in troubles
